headline: IMM România and FORT call for legislative changes so that the reduction in the diesel excise duty is reflected in the real price at the pump
summary: IMM România and FORT are calling for legislative changes so that the reduction in the diesel excise duty is reflected in actual pump prices.
why: Excise duties are a major component of retail fuel prices, so changes in them feed directly into transport costs and inflation for businesses and households.

original_headline: IMM România și FORT cer modificarea legislației astfel încât reducerea accizei la motorină să se reflecte în prețul real la pompă
